messages:
Maya (partnerships): Quick heads-up — EdgeLink wants to go live in the cloud marketplace in 3 weeks. Marketplace requires SOC2 + a pen test and a short questionnaire. Who owns bundling and upload flow?
Lucas (security): Do we have the pen-scope? Third-party or vendor-conducted? That changes acceptance criteria.
Priya (SI): EdgeLink is an SI partner; they can surface artifacts but ask if we want a single consolidated bundle or per-artifact presigns.
Ellie (platform-eng): I'd vote for a single presigned ZIP with a small manifest (machine-readable) so intake automation can index quickly. Also reduces OSS leakage risk.
Maya (partnerships): Got it. Timeline pressure — we need an action list: manifest schema, redaction rules, upload location, owner for presigns, and acceptance checklist.
Tom (legal): Redaction rules: vendor needs to remove customer PII and ephemeral API keys. We require attestations signed by an officer (name + date). Retention: 12 months unless contract says otherwise.
Lucas (security): Acceptance checklist (high level): 1) Valid SOC2 attestation (pdf + scope) 2) Pen test with scope and remediation timeline 3) Completed questionnaire answers 4) Signed attestation 5) MD5 checksums in manifest. If any live credentials are present -> reject.
Priya (SI): For uploads we can support S3 presigned URLs. If you want the single ZIP approach, vendor can upload files to our intake S3 path and then we create the ZIP server-side. Prefer the manifest-first pattern: vendor posts manifest.json, we validate, then accept artifacts.
Ellie (platform-eng): Suggested manifest example (minimal):
```json
{
  "vendor":"EdgeLink",
  "bundle_version":"1.0",
  "generated_at":"2025-06-05T14:00:00Z",
  "items": [
    {"type":"soc2","file":"soc2-2024.pdf","scope":"prod","sha256":"<hex>"},
    {"type":"pen-test","file":"pentest-may-2025.pdf","scope":"edge-gw","sha256":"<hex>"}
  ],
  "attestation_contact":"security@redwood.ai"
}
```
Maya (partnerships): That looks good. Who will run redaction checks? Manual or automated?
Lucas (security): Basic checks automated: filetypes, presence of attestation, sha256. Redaction (PII) needs a manual glance for PDFs unless partner uses our redaction script. We can provide a small redaction checklist and script.
Tom (legal): Legal will confirm attestation wording. We need a clause that the vendor certifies removal of customer data.
Priya (SI): Ops question: naming convention for S3 path? I suggest `marketplace/<vendor>/<listing_id>/<bundle_ts>/`. Makes lifecycle cleanup simple.
Ellie (platform-eng): Agreed. Also we should store a csv index in the bundle: `index.csv` with columns [filename,type,sha256,scope,uploaded_by]. Automates ingestion.
Maya (partnerships): Action items: Lucas -> finalize acceptance checklist + redaction script by EOD Thursday. Tom -> draft attestation text by Friday. Priya -> confirm vendor upload instructions + presign flow. Ellie -> put manifest + index template in shared drive and add intake validation lambda. I'll own comms to EdgeLink and schedule a short onboarding call.
Lucas (security): I'll also add a quick-risk flag for pen-test age > 12 months.
evidence-bot: Note recorded: task created #EVID-4421 (owner=Maya, due=2025-06-12).
Priya (SI): One more ask from SI side — can we request sanitized logs from the vendor if pen-test references specific endpoints? Might be helpful for verification.
Maya (partnerships): Good call. We'll add "supporting logs" as optional but recommended. I'll draft the vendor checklist and post it here. :thumbsup:
